description.value:
You secrete enough poisonous chemicals to afflict other creatures. As part of your daily preparations, you create two doses of gnarefuroid toxin. These poisons can't be properly used by any other creature, have no value, and become inert when you next make your daily preparations. The poison's save DC uses the higher of your class or spell DC.

Gnarefuroid Toxin (injury, poison)

Saving Throw @Check[type:fortitude|against:class-spell]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison damage, enfeebled 1, and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage, enfeebled 1, and clumsy 1 (1 round)
